notes.f1: Recovered in full: I1 Angela Alvarado Duran with ParentChild R7 to K21K-P1C and R8 to K4JL-NPF, burial 20 Jun 1880 at Nuestra Senora del Carmen, birth ~1879 and christening 27 Mar 1879 -- the corrected year, not the draft's 1880. Confidence high: the burial entry reads 'de ano y dos meses', and the same-page handwriting controls (no. 813 'de ano y seis meses' vs no. 810/817 'dos anos') distinguish that construction from 'dos anos'. In completed years and months that age places the birth between 21 March and 20 April 1879, a window her 27 Mar 1879 baptism falls inside, so the birth sits in the week of 21-27 March 1879.
